summary: Hot October CPI and hawkish Fed talk; indexes down about 0.5-1%. No trade's reason has been contradicted: eleven holds.

Only new item is the Indra toll-collection selection (11-10); stock -2.2% on a down day, still well above the gap day's middle.

McDonald's partnership expansion and Citi resuming at Buy (11-09); a robotaxi engineering leader's exit is the one negative. UBER lags SPY today on no thesis-level news.
No Cognex or peer news on 11-09 or 11-10; the stock is outpacing XLI both days, which is price against the short, not a changed story.
